_comment: The printer. lcd codes are keyed by src/sim/printer.ts — every code the machine can emit must exist here. The service diagram inside panel A is for a different model and its arrows run the wrong way; that is both the joke and a fact the player genuinely learns.

window.title: Printer - Properties
window.hint: A B C D open panels  ·  Enter pull  ·  Esc leave it
window.diagram: A service diagram is taped inside. It is for the 4ML. This is the 4ML-e.
window.diagramLearned: The diagram is for the 4ML. Somebody has corrected the arrows in biro.

clearedUnwitnessed: The sheet comes out whole. Nobody sees. The printer says READY, to you, personally.
Cleared. You put the panels back. There is no record of this.
clearedWitnessed: {name} watches you get it out in one piece. "Oh, thank God."
{name} sees the whole thing. This will be mentioned. It will be mentioned to others.
torn: It comes apart. Half of it is still in there, further in than before.
A clean tear, straight across. The half you are holding is not the useful half.
shredded: Confetti. The machine will not be printing today, and everyone will find out at once.
That is not paper any more. You close the panels on it and walk away, which is all anyone can do.
abandoned: You put the panels back roughly where they were.
alreadyShredded: E-99. Somebody would have to actually fix it, and nobody here does that.

ticket.raise: "I'll raise a ticket. The ticket will go to me. I'll see it tomorrow."
ticket.rush: "Fine. FINE. I'll look at it before lunch, and we never discussed it."
ticket.already: "There's already a ticket. It's with me. I'm aware of it."
ticket.fixed: The printer is working. There is no sign anyone touched it.
